sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The only approval for Chisone on BR-310 is for Pinerolo. The ASL has no approval for Beinasco (PLT-BEI) for this part and customer. Chisone's return to approved status on 2026-11-06 qualifies the company only and does not add a part or plant approval.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-310 is drawn in EN AW-6082-T5, so the open issue applies to this part.
